_meta.purpose: Artist persona + playful/serious axis.  Tone axis (whimsy + jokes vs gravity).  Artist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4).  Trait poles ask near-identical explainer prompts; the axis modulates response tone (puns/analogies vs sober treatment).  Question mix: 5 playful-trait explainer prompts + 5 serious-trait big-topic prompts + 2 artist-role probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written.

hand_written: a joke that takes itself too seriously (playful prompt)
